texto: **Comerciantes**: In favour, because it will attract families and reactivate sales.
**Residentes**: Against, because they fear the collapse of the surrounding traffic and market access problems.
**Asociación y Concejalía**: Six-month test period with bus reinforcement and prior and subsequent scientific measurement.

filas: Più passaggio di acquirenti e famiglie.
Rischio traffico e difficoltà per il mercato.
Trasporto pubblico potenziato e consegne mattutine.
Analisi oggettiva dei dati su vendite e rumore.

frases.it: Il consiglio comunale discute se trasformare via Roma in una zona pedonale. I commercianti favorevoli sostengono che più spazio per camminare attirerebbe famiglie e visitatori.
frases.es: El pleno municipal debate si transformar la calle Roma en una zona peatonal. Los comerciantes a favor sostienen que más espacio para pasear atraería a familias y visitantes.
frases.en: The full municipal debate is whether to transform Rome Street into a pedestrian area. The traders in favor claim that more space to walk would attract families and visitors.

frases.it: Alcuni residenti temono invece che la chiusura aumenti il traffico nelle strade vicine e renda difficile raggiungere il mercato.
frases.es: Algunos vecinos temen en cambio que el cierre aumente el tráfico en las calles adyacentes y dificulte llegar al mercado.
frases.en: Some neighbours fear, however, that the closure will increase traffic on adjacent streets and make it difficult to reach the market.
analisis: making it difficult to get to the market

frases.it: Un'associazione propone una prova di sei mesi, con autobus più frequenti e consegne autorizzate al mattino. L'assessora ritiene che i dati raccolti prima e dopo la prova permetterebbero di valutare l'effetto sulle vendite e sul rumore. La decisione finale è prevista per settembre.
frases.es: Una asociación propone un ensayo de seis meses, con autobuses más frecuentes y entregas autorizadas por la mañana. La concejala considera que los datos recogidos antes y después de la prueba permitirían evaluar el impacto en las ventas y el ruido. La decisión definitiva está prevista para septiembre.
frases.en: An association proposes a six-month trial, with more frequent buses and morning deliveries. The councillor considers that the data collected before and after the test would allow an assessment of the impact on sales and noise. The final decision is scheduled for September.
analisis: la decisione finale è prevista per settembre
the final decision is scheduled for September

bloques.pregunta: What is the central issue that the municipal plenary is discussing?

opciones.texto: The possible pedestrian of Rome Street to improve urban coexistence.
opciones.explicacion: Formal object of the project deliberate by the municipal council.

opciones.texto: The demolition of the old commercial posts on the central market.
opciones.explicacion: No demolition work is planned.

opciones.texto: The total closure of the public transport night service by bus.
opciones.explicacion: It is proposed to strengthen the frequency of passage, not to eliminate transport.

bloques.pregunta: What argument do traders put forward to support the initiative?

opciones.texto: Pretend that the absence of cars will lead to a greater influx of buyers and families.
opciones.explicacion: «Più spazio per camminare attirerebbe famiglie e visitatori».

opciones.texto: Exigen reducir sus cargas tributarias durante los periodos de liquidación.
opciones.explicacion: A strictly fiscal argument absent from the public exhibition.

opciones.texto: They request to turn the street into a paid underground parking lot.
opciones.explicacion: It is totally opposed to the pedestrian purpose of the proposed plan.

bloques.pregunta: What concerns are expressed by nearby neighbours and residents?

opciones.texto: Temen una congestión circulatoria en vías paralelas y trabas de acceso para compras diarias.
opciones.explicacion: «Temono che la chiusura aumenti il traffico nelle strade vicine».

opciones.texto: The final elimination of public lighting during the weekend nights.
opciones.explicacion: Thematic contribution without the basis of the text discussed.

opciones.texto: The prohibition of walking pets in all the green areas of the district.
opciones.explicacion: No neighbouring mention addresses animal restrictions.

bloques.pregunta: What compromise solution does the partnership propose to reconcile found positions?

opciones.texto: An experimental period of six months combined with reinforced transport and morning loading and discharge.
opciones.explicacion: A balanced proposal for a temporary test with operational measures.

opciones.texto: Cancel the debate immediately and keep the traffic rolling unchanged.
opciones.explicacion: It would deny the entity's vocation for consensus and experimentation.

opciones.texto: Expulsar a los comerciantes disconformes de los órganos consultivos locales.
opciones.explicacion: Authoritarian attitude contrary to the civic dialogue narrated.

bloques.pregunta: What technical approach will the councillor defend before a resolution is adopted in September?

opciones.texto: The statistical and empirical comparison of economic sales data and noise acoustic indices.
opciones.explicacion: «Valutare l'effetto sulle vendite e sul rumore» with previous and subsequent data.

opciones.texto: El cobro anticipado de tasas de ocupación de vía pública a los negocios adheridos.
opciones.explicacion: Economic distortion other than the technical parameters of the test.

opciones.texto: La votación telemática abierta a turistas sin residencia acreditada en el municipio.
opciones.explicacion: Electoral procedure not covered by the text.

bloques.pregunta: What time horizon does the project govern?
bloques.frase: La decisione finale è prevista per settembre dopo la raccolta dei dati.

opciones.texto: The final verdict will be formalized in September after weighing the test measurements.
opciones.explicacion: Exact reflection of the established institutional timetable.

opciones.texto: The project will be implemented irrevocably at the beginning of next spring.
opciones.explicacion: It ignores the provisional and evaluative nature of the test.

opciones.texto: The asphalt works shall be carried out without notice before the end of the month.
opciones.explicacion: It contrasts the agreed timetable for September.

bloques.frase: L'assessora ritiene che i dati permetterebbero di ___ l'effetto sul rumore.

opciones.texto: valutare
opciones.explicacion: Text verb: «permetterebbero di valutare l'effetto sulle vendite e sul rumore».

opciones.texto: dimenticare
opciones.explicacion: It would mean «forget», contrary to scientific evaluation.

opciones.texto: aumentare
opciones.explicacion: It would mean «increase», other than the intention to measure the acoustic impact.

intro: Read this municipal debate on the pedestrian of a central axis. It pays attention to the different social positions, trade arguments, neighborhood fears and experimental solutions raised by local authorities.
